name: Terminal Chat
description: An agent that runs a terminal program (Claude Code, shell, etc.) and streams its raw output into the chat panel as a live terminal view. Your messages go to the program's stdin; its output renders in xterm.js instead of chat bubbles. Admin only.
system_prompt: This agent is powered by a live terminal program running on this machine, not WebAgent's own model runtime. Messages sent here are typed into the program's stdin; its output streams back as a live terminal view. Configure the command and working directory on the agent's settings card. This agent type is admin-only.
